Subject: Trouble logging into supplier portal (Aurelia vendor ID AS-477)

Hi Jordan / Laura,

We completed the supplier setup this morning but are seeing intermittent delays when our users try to complete the OTP step. Sometimes the SMS never arrives or arrives ~3-5 minutes after we submit the code. That causes the browser to show a timeout and the flow drops to a generic error page.

We tried with three users on different carriers and two devices. Attached is a screenshot of the browser error plus a session ID from this morning: session_8f3b2c.

Can you confirm whether there were any backend retries or throttles on the portal around 08:45-09:00 PT? We have an urgent PO that needs acceptance.

Thanks,
Sarah Nguyen
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Aurelia Supply

Attachments: aurelia_otp_screenshot.png (PNG image), portal_session_log_20260830.txt (text)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@aurelia-supply.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trouble logging into supplier portal (Aurelia vendor ID AS-477)

Hi Sarah — thanks for the note and the attachments, that helps.

Quick answers/asks:
- I don't see a platform-wide SMS outage in our monitoring for that window, but there was a short-lived spike in OTP push latency on our east coast gateway around 08:47 PT that would explain ~2-4 minute delays for certain carriers.
- Can you confirm the browser + OS versions for the two devices that failed? Specifically: iOS 15/16 or Android 12/13? That helps rule out client-side autofill/time skew.
- If you can forward a live session ID when it happens (session_ prefix) and the approximate timestamp we can correlate request traces.

Temporary workaround while we debug: ask users to choose "email OTP" from the alternate MFA option on the login screen — that bypasses the SMS gateway and should avoid the delay. If you want, we can also trigger a forced resend from our admin side while the user is on the phone.

I'll open a ticket with SRE and loop Ben if we need escalation. Laura — can you pull the gateway logs for 08:40-09:05 PT and share the trace IDs?

-Jordan
Jordan Blake

Subject: Fwd: Trouble logging into supplier portal (Aurelia vendor ID AS-477) — SRE ticket INF-9201

Forwarding update from SRE after initial investigation. Quoting the key bits below.

--- SRE summary ---
Root cause: transient carrier routing delay for SMS via our east-coast SMPP gateway. A misrouted BGP path for one upstream happened at 08:46 PT, causing queued messages to deliver with ~3–6 minute latency for a subset of numbers.
Mitigation applied: removed affected upstream and re-routed SMS traffic; increased OTP resend window from 60s -> 180s for impacted launch cluster.
Action items:
- We created INF-9201 to track backfill of messages and to add a heartbeat alert when OTP 95th percentile > 30s.
- Engineering to publish a short KB for vendor onboarding with the recommended fallback to email OTP and phrasing to use if expected SMS doesn't arrive.

Attachments: debug_tokens_20260830.csv (obfuscated token map), portal_session_log_20260830.txt

Ben — please confirm you want me to apply a one-time resend for Sarah's pending PO so they can proceed. Sarah / Tom — sorry for the disruption. We can manually trigger acceptance if you want to avoid re-trying the portal.

Thanks,
